FN-RLZXMMY-2
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 258
Committee: Transportation and Energy Sponsor: Senator Keith Kelley
Analyst: Jennifer Farish Date: 04/04/2024
Senate Bill 258 as reported by the Committee on Transportation and Energy would codify the
existing commercial driver license fee schedule and repeal certain fines and safety certification
requirements to be in compliance with federal law. This bill would not affect state or local
funding. However, if not enacted by September 30, 2024, the Alabama Law Enforcement
Agency (ALEA) could be subject to having its federal Motor Carrier Safety Assistance Program
funding withheld. Per ALEA, an estimated $9 million is the amount that could be held for
noncompliance.

FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 258
Committee: Transportation, Utilities and Sponsor: Senator Keith Kelley
Infrastructure
Analyst: Jennifer Farish Date: 04/16/2024
Senate Bill 258 as passed the Senate would codify the existing commercial driver license fee
schedule and repeal certain fines and safety certification requirements to be in compliance with
federal law. If not enacted by September 30, 2024, the Alabama Law Enforcement Agency
(ALEA) is subject to having an estimated $9 million in annual federal Motor Carrier Safety
Assistance Program funding withheld for noncompliance. This bill would not otherwise affect
state or local funding.
